title: AI's land problem is pushing data centers into the ocean (Fortune / The Conversation)
notes: Fortune (top-tier), republished The Conversation expert article by Nir Kshetri. Supports: main environmental concern = warm seawater discharge affecting oxygen levels, pH, marine life; HiCloud (Hainan UDC contractor) reported <1°C temperature increase in nearby seawater; SIN01 Sines returns seawater ~1°C warmer; Shanghai Lingang wind-powered UDC uses >=30% less electricity; Microsoft Natick ended 2024; UNESCO ~60% of marine ecosystems degraded. No report of ecosystem distortion or fisher displacement; no independent formal impact study cited.
